part.pin.title: Pin
part.pin.summary: A piece stuck in front of the king cannot move; in front of a bigger piece, it moves at a high price. Attack the pinned piece again.
ex.pin.v18W3: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.pin.v18W3.hint: Look for a black piece pinned to the king: it can neither capture nor block.
ex.pin.v18W3.solution: 17.Ng6#! The knight gives check on g6, and the pawn on h7 cannot capture it: the queen on h5 pins it to the king.
ex.pin.69GPY: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.pin.69GPY.hint: Look for a white piece pinned to the king: it can neither capture nor block.
ex.pin.69GPY.solution: 38...Ra1#! The rook gives check on the first rank, and the rook on f2 cannot block on f1: the bishop on b6 pins it to the king.
ex.pin.jhCCp: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.pin.jhCCp.hint: Look for a black piece pinned to the king: it can neither capture nor block.
ex.pin.jhCCp.solution: 16.Re8#! The rook gives check on the eighth rank, and the rook on f7 cannot block on f8: the bishop on c4 pins it to the king.
ex.pin.39Eek: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.pin.39Eek.hint: Look for a white piece pinned to the king: it can neither capture nor block.
ex.pin.39Eek.solution: 28...Nf3#! The knight gives check on f3, and the pawn on g2 cannot capture it: the rook on g7 pins it to the king.
ex.pin.nUFfh: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.pin.nUFfh.hint: Look for a white piece you can pin to the king.
ex.pin.nUFfh.solution: 15...Bf5! The bishop pins the queen on e4 to the king on b1. After 16.Qxf5, 16...gxf5 recaptures: Black wins the queen for a bishop.
ex.pin.KIpz7: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.pin.KIpz7.hint: Before retreating, see what stands behind the pawn that defends b5.
ex.pin.KIpz7.solution: 13.Bxb5! The pawn on a6 is pinned to the rook on a8. After 13...axb5, 14.Qxa8+ captures the rook.
ex.pin.M8uTb: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.pin.M8uTb.hint: Look for a white piece you can pin to the king.
ex.pin.M8uTb.solution: 13...Bh6! The bishop pins the queen on f4 to the king on c1. After 14.Qxh6, 14...Rxh6 recaptures: Black wins the queen for a bishop.
ex.pin.pqb0n: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.pin.pqb0n.hint: Look for a move that leaves a black piece pinned to the king and then attack that piece again.
ex.pin.pqb0n.solution: 22.Qxe6+! The queen captures the pawn with check and attacks the bishop on e7. After 22...Rd7, the rook is pinned to the king, and 23.Rxd4 attacks it again.
